reviewType: Independent model-agent blind educational review, not human sign-off
blindness: No stage8 source packages, proposed keys, explanations, or prior subject reports read before this ledger. Only administrative AGENTS/ARCHITECTURE/PLAN, blinded prompts/options, and official sources consulted.
scope: 120 questions independently solved; no DB access, app edits or git operations.
assumptions: Lengths positive; school right-circular-cone convention flagged where used.
Random draws uniform among individual balls or unordered samples; standard fair die six-sided.
Numeric values exact; decimal comma and decimal point equivalent.

officialSources.use: Personally read official 2026 domains and question forms. Calculations independently derived.
Official syllabus landing identified; fetch failed. Full current PDF not personally inspected.
Official search excerpt confirms antiderivative and definite integral topics.

overallObservations.message: All30 assigned HARD items are short standard school tasks and better MEDIUM. Many MEDIUM items are direct formulas and better EASY. Requires empirical calibration.
Every module has first four single-choice answers А,Б,В,Г respectively. Randomize choice positions to avoid a predictable guessing cue.
Basic practice pool alone does not establish full NMT readiness: no graphs/diagrams, limited inequalities and nonroutine reasoning. Withheld lessons not assessed in phase1.
